text:
nina: Quick heads-up: Azure Marketplace settlement posted a +$3,750 reversal on reseller account (Reseller: BrightWave) but it landed as a charge type 'CustomerRefund' on invoice BW-2026-04. Partner says they expected a marketplace-level reversal tied to order OR-445322. Can someone confirm classification?
azure-billing-bot: Auto-detect: Settlement discrepancy for order OR-445322. Posted 2026-04-08T05:12Z. Adjustment id: AZ-REV-20260408-BW. Type: CustomerRefund.
leo: I pulled the settlement file from our SFTP. The line item has code 14 (refund) which we currently map to CustomerRefund. If Azure intended marketplace reversal, code should be 34 (MarketplaceAdjustment).
ony: typo, meant to be tony: tagging @finance-ops. We need to know whether to reclassify in GL or ask Azure to reissue as marketplace adj. Partner needs a clean credit memo for their AR team.
finance-ops: Holding any cash application. Created JE-BW-2026-04-HOLD for +3750 until we confirm. Can @nina attach the settlement CSV row?
nina: Pasting CSV row: ```csv
2026-04-08,OR-445322,AZ-REV-20260408-BW,14,3750,USD
```
leo: Thanks. Looks like Azure sent code 14. I can reach out to our Azure rep but historically they'll issue a contra-entry only if it's a partner-level marketplace reversal. Otherwise we need to reclass ourselves and produce a partner-facing memo.
anna: finance-ops here. If we reclass internally, what's the account movement? Do we net revenue or post contra-rev? Need exact GL lines for the partner note.
leo: Proposed: reverse revenue on sales acct 4001 and create contra marketplace credit 6502. JE example: DR 6502 +3750, CR 4001 +3750. Tagging @anna to confirm.
anna: That works for reseller-facing reporting. But partner invoice format expects 'Marketplace Credit' language. Can someone get Azure to reissue with code 34?
ina: Opening Azure case: case 78901234. Requesting reclassification to MarketplaceAdjustment (code 34) and asking for a partner-facing credit memo PDF. Will update.
azure-billing-bot: Case 78901234 status: OPEN. Estimated response 72 hours.
ton y: Meanwhile, I'll draft a one-line memo to BrightWave explaining we're holding the amount as a temporary credit and will issue partner memo once Azure confirms.
paul: (not in channel) -- ignore
finance-ops: Once Azure confirms, we'll post JE-BW-2026-04-CREDIT referencing AZ-REV-20260408-BW. If Azure declines, we'll post the internal reclass and provide partner memo.
nina: Update: Azure responded - they acknowledge and will issue a MarketplaceAdjustment (code 34) plus a PDF credit memo by 2026-04-12. Case 78901234 -> UPDATED.
leo: Great. Please drop the PDF here and we'll process.
anna: Removing hold and scheduling post for 2026-04-13 after we receive memo.
ina: Uploading Azure PDF when it arrives. Thanks all. :v:
